preconditions.description: The number of gifts is between 1 and 200,000.
The pleasantness of each gift is an integer between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
Each gift id is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The tree structure is given by (u_i, v_i) pairs such that all gifts hang on the first gift.
preconditions.description: The tree is rooted at gift 1, and each gift (other than 1) is connected to exactly one other gift by a rope.

postconditions.expression: output is either an integer or the string 'Impossible'
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of pleasantness that Chloe and Vladik can get, or 'Impossible' if they cannot choose gifts without fighting.
